scope: Bounded official forecast-source retrieval for Kaub station 25700100; no contract probability or verdict.

current_elwis_page.finding: Page says deterministic ELWIS forecast/estimate was issued 2026-10-19 07:00 and displays through Oct23. This is the short-range product, distinct from linked probabilistic forecasts; the table's compact columns were not mapped to exact forecast timestamps in this pass.

probabilistic_14day.horizon: Oct18–31, daily means (each 00:00 to 00:00 next day).
probabilistic_14day.metric: Printed table gives probability of undershooting fixed water-level thresholds, based on daily mean; values for GlW=77 cm by date Oct18–31 are [100,100,100,100,100,100,99,77,51,29,23,23,28,35] percent.
probabilistic_14day.method: PDF says it uses current measurements at about 50 Rhine-basin gauges and over 900 weather stations; ECMWF ENS (51 members), deterministic ICON-EU for the first five forecast days and ICON for days 6–7; BfG hydrologic, hydraulic and statistical models; EMOS calibration from 53 underlying water-level forecasts. Probabilities are calculated on daily means. It cautions meteorological uncertainty increases with horizon and that the estimates are automated and based partly on mostly unchecked observations.
probabilistic_14day.interpretation_limit: These are daily-mean threshold probabilities, not the probability that any 15-minute W reading reaches 77 cm, nor a direct probability of the market's first qualifying timestamp. Do not invert the daily-mean undershoot row into contract odds. PDF says a 80% undershoot probability means statistical undershoot in 8/10 cases; it also describes the plotted 5th–95th percentile band as leaving 5% in each tail on average.

probabilistic_6week.horizon: Six weeks / 46 forecast days; weekly-mean levels through Nov25. Week3 is Oct29–Nov4.
probabilistic_6week.method: PDF describes 101 equally likely ECMWF sub-seasonal weather scenarios processed through a water-balance model using hydrologic history and future weather, then a current rating curve. It compares current forecast with a 30-member climatological forecast and 1991–2020 observations; the skill scale is retrospectively assessed on 2016–2023 forecasts. It says this product focuses on medium/low water, gives weekly means, and uncertainty increases with lead time.
probabilistic_6week.threshold_limit: Week3 text classes are low <105 cm, somewhat lower <137, medium <172, somewhat higher <212, and high >212. GlW=77 cm lies within the broad low class; the text class boundaries do not identify the fraction below/above 77. The PDF graphical ensemble shares were not numerically extracted here.

limits: The 14-day PDF is the only captured official probabilistic product spanning every October date through Oct31. It is dated Oct18, not a forecast initialized Oct19; the current ELWIS deterministic page is newer but only displays to Oct23. The 6-week product is dated Oct15 and uses weekly means. Forecasts are not observations or exact-any-reading event probabilities.
